"""Repro for sphinx issue #9575: autoclass + autodoc_typehints='description'
adds a bogus 'Return type' for classes."""
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "C:/Users/agent/work/projects/stack/campaign")

from sphinx.application import Sphinx  # noqa: E402
from sphinx.util.docutils import docutils_namespace, patch_docutils  # noqa: E402

srcdir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="repro9575-"))
(srcdir / "sample_package").mkdir()
(srcdir / "sample_package" / "__init__.py").write_text(
    'class Square:\n'
    '    """A class representing a square figure."""\n'
    '\n'
    '    def __init__(self, width: int, height: int) -> None:\n'
    '        self.width = width\n'
    '        self.height = height\n'
)
(srcdir / "conf.py").write_text(
    "extensions = ['sphinx.ext.autodoc']\n"
    "autodoc_typehints = 'description'\n"
)
(srcdir / "index.rst").write_text(
    ".. autoclass:: sample_package.Square\n"
    "   :members:\n"
)

with patch_docutils(), docutils_namespace():
    app = Sphinx(str(srcdir), str(srcdir), str(srcdir / "_build"),
                 str(srcdir / "_build" / "doctree"), "text")
    app.build()

out = (srcdir / "_build" / "index.txt").read_text()
print("=== OUTPUT ===")
print(out)
print("=== BUG PRESENT ===" if "Return type" in out else "=== NO BUG ===")

OUT=typehints_results.txt
: > "$OUT"

  test_autodoc_typehints_description \
  test_autodoc_typehints_description_no_undoc \
  test_autodoc_typehints_description_no_undoc_doc_rtype \

  code=$?
  echo "TEST $t exit=$code $(tail -1 .last_test_out.txt)" >> "$OUT"
done

echo ALLDONE >> "$OUT"
